FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY product_count DESC, product_category_name ASC

SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM sellers

body.sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(price), 2) AS max_price, ROUND(MIN(price), 2) AS min_price FROM order_items LIMIT 201

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01';

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_product_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT t.order_month, ROUND(AVG(t.order_amount), 2) AS avg_order_amount
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS order_amount
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
) t
GROUP BY t.order_month
ORDER BY t.order_month
LIMIT 1000;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY 1
),
cal AS (
  SELECT generate_series((SELECT MIN(m) FROM monthly), (SELECT MAX(m) FROM monthly), interval '1 month') AS m
)
SELECT c.m::date AS month,
       ROUND((mg.cnt - LAG(mg.cnt) OVER (ORDER BY c.m))::numeric
             / NULLIF(LAG(mg.cnt) OVER (ORDER BY c.m), 0), 4) AS growth_rate
FROM cal c
LEFT JOIN monthly mg ON mg.m = c.m
ORDER BY c.m
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS order_hour,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_hour
ORDER BY order_count DESC, order_hour ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL), 0), 4) AS late_delivery_rate FROM orders o LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', r.requested_at) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount
FROM refunds r
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 100;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_resolution_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', review_creation_date) AS month, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM order_reviews
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members
WHERE last_login_date >= (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members) - INTERVAL '29 days'
  AND last_login_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members);

SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_unique_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
FROM sellers s
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, s.seller_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM product_price_history h
  WHERE h.product_id = p.product_id
);

SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_payment_value
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
LIMIT 100;

SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_product_amount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_status
ORDER BY o.order_status
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.customer_state ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.payment_type, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, payment_type FROM order_payments) p
  ON p.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY p.payment_type
ORDER BY p.payment_type
LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS product_sales_excluding_freight
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state
GROUP BY r.macro_region
ORDER BY product_sales_excluding_freight DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT m.level_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_amount
FROM members m
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY m.level_id
ORDER BY m.level_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ca.campaign_id, COUNT(cu.usage_id) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns ca
JOIN coupons c ON c.campaign_id = ca.campaign_id
JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = c.coupon_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id
ORDER BY ca.campaign_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.discount_type, ROUND(SUM(cu.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount_amount
FROM coupon_usages cu
JOIN coupons c ON c.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id
GROUP BY c.discount_type
LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.macro_region, SUM(w.capacity) AS total_capacity
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
GROUP BY r.macro_region
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, ROUND(AVG(quantity)::numeric, 2) AS avg_quantity
FROM inventory
GROUP BY warehouse_id
ORDER BY warehouse_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
LIMIT 100;

SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(s.total_amount), 2) AS total_settlement_amount
FROM settlements s
WHERE s.total_amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY total_settlement_amount DESC, s.seller_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.refund_id) AS refund_order_cnt
FROM refund_items ri
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY refund_order_cnt DESC, p.product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 100;
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS refund_order_ratio FROM orders o LIMIT 201

SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(track_cnt)::numeric, 2) AS avg_tracking_records
FROM (
  SELECT s.status, s.shipment_id, COUNT(t.tracking_id) AS track_cnt
  FROM shipments s
  LEFT JOIN shipment_tracking t ON t.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  GROUP BY s.status, s.shipment_id
) x
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.product_category_name,
       ROUND(AVG(p.product_weight_g)::numeric, 2) AS avg_product_weight
FROM products p
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, p.product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.level_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS amount
FROM members m
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY m.level_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT w.region_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id) AS shipment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS order_count
FROM shipments s
LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
GROUP BY w.region_code
ORDER BY w.region_code NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.customer_state, m.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN members m ON m.member_id = st.member_id
WHERE tc.category_name = '物流延迟'
GROUP BY c.customer_state, m.level_id
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, c.customer_state ASC NULLS LAST, m.level_id ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

SELECT mr.level_id AS referrer_level_id, mi.level_id AS invitee_level_id,
       COUNT(*) AS referral_count,
       ROUND(SUM(rf.reward_amount), 2) AS reward_total
FROM referrals rf
LEFT JOIN members mr ON mr.member_id = rf.referrer_member_id
LEFT JOIN members mi ON mi.member_id = rf.invitee_member_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY referral_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT b.brand_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS amount
FROM brands b
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.brand_id = b.brand_id AND pbm.is_current = true
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pbm.product_id
GROUP BY b.brand_id
ORDER BY amount DESC, b.brand_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT cp.campaign_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS product_amount
FROM campaign_products cp
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = cp.product_id
GROUP BY cp.campaign_id
ORDER BY product_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  t.event_code,
  c.customer_state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.shipment_id) AS shipment_count
FROM shipment_tracking t
LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id = t.shipment_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY t.event_code, c.customer_state
ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, t.event_code ASC, c.customer_state ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

SELECT st.category_id,
       st.priority,
       COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count,
       COUNT(tm.message_id) AS message_count
FROM support_tickets st
LEFT JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id = st.ticket_id
GROUP BY st.category_id, st.priority
LIMIT 1000;

-- 以库存变动流水为事实表，左连接仓库与区域以保留未知大区NULL，不连接当前库存表
SELECT r.macro_region, m.movement_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count, SUM(m.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM inventory_movements m
LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = m.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
GROUP BY r.macro_region, m.movement_type
ORDER BY r.macro_region NULLS LAST, m.movement_type
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS gmv_with_freight, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales_without_freight FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_rate FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) t LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE m.member_id IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS member_order_pct FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS refund_rate FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score BETWEEN 1 AND 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS low_rating_pct
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY low_rating_pct DESC, c.customer_state ASC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS ctr FROM search_logs LIMIT 201

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mo.m)::int AS month, ma.mau
FROM (SELECT generate_series(DATE '2018-01-01', DATE '2018-12-01', INTERVAL '1 month')::date AS m) mo
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS m,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS mau
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
) ma ON ma.m = mo.m
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 12;
